description: Get trending stock tickers from Reddit based on mention frequency. Scans r/wallstreetbets, r/stocks, r/investing, and r/options for posts mentioning tickers. Returns tickers sorted by mention count with per-subreddit breakdown. Limitation: uses keyword extraction (cashtags + uppercase words), not NLP — some false positives possible. Best for gauging retail buzz, not precise sentiment.

limit.description: Maximum number of trending tickers to return (default: 20)

subreddits.description: Subreddits to scan (default: wallstreetbets, stocks, investing, options)

name: reddit_trending
